fullContent:
Putapakwa Visham Jwarantak Lauh 
 Reference: Rasendra Sara Sangraha, Jvaradhikara. 
 Introduction 
 Putapakwa Visham Jwarantak Lauh is classical formulation that pacifies pitta and Kapha and is herbo-mineral formulation in Ayurveda. This Ayurvedic medicine is tridoshnashk. It acts as antiperiodic and diaphoretic Ayurvedic agent. This medicine is useful in treating fevers. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada (Purified Mercury) 4 Parts 
 Shuddha Gandhak (Purified sulphur)  4 Parts 
 Hema (Svarna) bhasma 1 Parts 
 Lauha Bhasma 8 Parts 
 Tamra Bhasma 8 Parts 
 Abhraka Bhasma 8 Parts 
 Vanga Bhasma 2 Parts 
 Pravala Bhasma 2 Parts 
 Mukta Bhasma 1 Parts 
 Shankha Bhasma 1 Parts 
 Shukti Bhasma 1 Parts 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Prepare parpati by mixing parad and Gandhak. Then all other ingredients are mixed together and after drying keep this one in the Samputha of Mukta shukti and Laghu Putha is given. After the Putha, The shells are removed and then Bhasma alone is taken. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 65 mg-125 mg with Tulsi leaves juice/ Pippali/ roasted Hingu asafoetida / Saindhava Lavana + honey, followed by hot water. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is useful in every type of fever and chronic fever. 
 It also good to improve digestion. 
 It is also efficient in treating anemia. 
 It is a beneficial Ayurvedic remedy for liver. 
 It improves strength and cures weakness. 
 It cures impaired digestion and metabolism. 
 
 Contraindications / Side Effects 
 
 This Ayurvedic medicine must be consumed under strict directions only. 
 Avoid its self-medication and over dose as it might be unsafe. 
 It is better to avoid in children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
